dep.name: provider
dep.purpose: Shared services, repositories, and lightweight state

dep.name: pointycastle
dep.purpose: Salsa20 stream cipher for GT7 telemetry decryption

dep.name: equatable
dep.purpose: Value equality for models and states

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-runtime-library: flutter_bloc for feature state, Provider for shared services
PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: Direct setState for feature state; use BLoC/Cubit instead.

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and widget checks

wave-level.focus: Checks only merged surfaces touched by a wave

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer mocktail fakes and narrow stubs over broad monkey-patching.

Observability.redaction: No secrets in telemetry data; network credentials must not appear in logs.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, or unclear third-party surface.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every completed step must emit assumptions, commands, evidence, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: Cross-platform Flutter app targeting iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web from a single codebase.
